identification: Four Anne Reilly (Australian studio potter, 1980s postmodern style) espresso cups on tripod-footed saucers, black and cream with swirl and dot decoration, one gold/yellow. Likely a Sottsass/Memphis-inspired postmodern studio pottery set.
